grid.rotation_note: 0 = true-north grid (axes aligned to pack E/N). Non-zero rotates grid-north clockwise from true north.
grid.index_axes: index i along grid-east, index j along grid-north; EN = origin + i*spacing*east_hat + j*spacing*north_hat

formulas.index_to_lnglat: east_hat=(cos θ, −sin θ), north_hat=(sin θ, cos θ) with θ=rotation_deg; E = E0 + i·s·east_e + j·s·north_e; N similar; lng = origin_lng + E/metres_per_deg_lng; lat = origin_lat + N/metres_per_deg_lat
formulas.lnglat_to_index: invert the linear map above (exact for equirectangular frame)

worked_example.note: roundtrip_index must equal index within float noise

solar_aligned.note: Same origin and spacing as true-north grid; rotate by June flat sunrise az
